The company offers screening, diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation services. It also provides hospital management services; and supplies pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and consumables. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Beijing, China.
